summary: One of two climbers on the Little Bear-Blanca traverse fell ~40 feet in the Hourglass, then ~10 more feet before self-arresting; knee injury and fatigue later left him unable to continue midway across the traverse; both climbers rappelled to a lower landing zone and were flown out.
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer SAR, Canon City Helitack, Eagle Air Med/REACH, Colorado State Patrol, Alamosa County Sheriff
notes: Second climber uninjured but extracted; outcome reflects the injury. AVSAR primary-source mission report.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: county (Alamosa County, Colorado, United States)
